name: ghost_create_dedicated
description:
Create a new dedicated database. Dedicated databases are always-on,
billed instances that are not subject to space compute or storage limits.
A payment method must be on file.

Use ghost_pricing to see compute and storage pricing.

Note: new databases may take a few minutes to start up. Use ghost_list to check the current status.

size.description: Database size — controls the CPU and memory allocated to the database

share_token.description: Share token from a database share. When provided, creates the new database from the shared snapshot.

wait.description: Wait for the database to be ready before returning. Set to true if your next steps require connecting to or querying the database.
